[Advertisement — commercial secondary school; Będzin.]
[P. 8, ads section, top row right; original in Polish (heading) and Yiddish]
3-class Secondary Commercial School
with the rights of state schools
of MARJA BOJARSKA in BĘDZIN, ul. Kołłątaja 45,
telephone 5-47
announces that new female pupils are admitted daily from 10
to 14 at the school office without examination, if they have completed an elementary
(powszechna) school or 3 classes of a gymnasium of the former type. The commercial school has
the rights of a secondary commercial school. Pupils from other towns pay
only 25 per cent on the railway. The fees have been reduced. To the 2nd
and 3rd classes pupils are admitted who have been promoted in
the same classes of other commercial schools.
209
—o—
[Advertisement — holiday pension; Kamieńsk.]
[P. 8, top row, centre; original in Yiddish]
Whoever
comes to
Kamieńsk
goes straight to the pension of Mrs. Mirowska,
villa of Dr. Kahn (formerly "Willa Róża"),
because only in this pension are there
comfortable, sunny, elegant rooms, the finest food,
strictly kosher and cheap. Every guest receives a free ticket
for the journey home.
412
—o—
[Advertisement — furniture for sale; Będzin.]
[P. 8, top row, left of the Kamieńsk ad; original in Yiddish]
A sideboard
for a dining room, with a mirror
and in the best condition, for sale
as a bargain. Enquire
at Lem[—]owicz, Będzin, 3-go
Maja 11.
—o—
[Advertisement — medicine (herbal remedy); general.]
[P. 8, left column top; original in Yiddish, product name in Polish]
[Picture: five doctors looking at a chart of the digestive organs; below in script: "Save your health" [?]]
The world's most famous doctors have established
that 75% of illnesses arise
because of constipation.
A sick stomach is the most important cause
of the onset of illnesses — it pollutes the
blood and creates a bad metabolism.
ZIOŁA Z GÓR HARCU [Herbs from the Harz Mountains]
of Dr. LAUER
as the greatest doctors have established,
are an ideal means for healing
the stomach, remove constipation, are a light
cleansing agent, ease the task
of the digestive organs, strengthen the
organism and awaken the appetite.
ZIOŁA Z GÓR HARCU of Dr. LAUER
remove ailments of the liver, kidneys, gallstones,
haemorrhoids, rheumatism and
arthritism.
The price of a box 1.50 zł.;
a double box 2.50 zł.
Obtainable in pharmacies and drugstores.
—o—
[Advertisement — children's pension; Szczyrk.]
[P. 8, second row right; heading in Polish, body in Yiddish]
Szczyrk
Willa "Juckera 572
Pension for children
and school youth. Kosher kitchen,
first-class care, child
supervision, special school
help, price 5 zł. daily.
—o—
[Advertisement — corn remedy; Warsaw.]
[P. 8, second row, left of the Szczyrk ad; original in Polish]
Corns,
hardened skin
and warts
removed painlessly
and for good by
KLAWIOL
[Picture: a KLAWIOL package]
"AP. KOWALSKI" WARSAW
—o—
[Notice — Agudath Israel, Centre for Palestine Affairs; Sosnowiec.]
[P. 8, second row, centre; original in Yiddish]
Centre for Eretz-Israel Affairs of "Agudath Israel in Poland", Sosnowiec branch
On Sunday, 2nd [?] of Balak, the 24th [?] of this month, at 12 o'clock, there will take place in the "Palace" cinema
a festive
Eretz-Israel Academy
for the opening of the district conference for the million campaign of the "Keren
HaYishuv" in Zagłębie. Taking part:
Rabbi and Gaon, Sejm deputy | President of Agudath Israel | Rabbi and Gaon, head of the rabbinical court of Prešov
Aharon Lewin | Yitzhak Meir Lewin | Moshe Chaim Lau
Tickets at the box office from 10 a.m. The gallery is reserved for women.
421
—o—
[Advertisement — the paper's own notice (sales at resorts); Krynica, Rajcza, Bystra.]
[P. 8, right column, third row; original in Yiddish]
— In —
Krynica, Rajcza, Bystra
single copies of the
"Zaglembier Tsaytung"
can be bought at the local newspaper kiosks and from the newspaper sellers.
—o—
[Advertisement — book (Szpigelman's bookshop); Będzin.]
[P. 8, centre of page, third row; original in Yiddish]
Eretz Israel — in word and picture!
Just published: the newest illustrated Eretz-Israel book
Moshe Mark ▼
"On the Roads
of Eretz Israel"
40 articles and feuilletons
by the overland route to Eretz Israel
descriptions of all the towns and colonies
28 pictures and illustrations
interviews with prominent personalities
travel impressions from 10 countries.
With a foreword by the well-known writer S. Szachnowicz
De luxe edition * 240 large pages * artistic cover
Price paperbound only 4.80 zł.
Libraries, booksellers — discount. Not sent cash on delivery, money in advance
Obtainable at Szpigelman's bookshop, Będzin, Kołłątaja 34.
—o—
[Advertisement — medicine (pills); Warsaw.]
[P. 8, left column, third row; original in Yiddish]
Reformation pills
[Picture: a monk holding a pill and a bottle]
of the "Monk" brand, known since the year
1682, regulate the stomach, cure rheumatism,
liver ailments, against corpulence,
arthritism, rush of blood to the head,
soothe the pains of haemorrhoids, cleanse
the blood, and with tendencies to constipation
— a convenient purgative.
To be taken 1 or 2 pills at night.
Price of a box 1.35. Made
by Aptekarz Tuszyński, Warsaw,
Smolna 22. Ask for them in the pharmacies
and drugstores, with the monk (zakonnik).
—o—
[Notice — private (summons to a rabbinical court); place not stated.]
[P. 8, right column, fourth row, at the right edge of the scan; original in Yiddish]
Summons.
I summon the [—]
Radomsko Rebbe, may he live long and happily,
to a Din Torah on Sunday [—]
Balak (the 24th of this month) concerning [—]
our dispute which I
have with the Rebbe,
Mordechai Hillel Wodzisławski
444
—o—
[Advertisement — anti-perspiration powder; Warsaw.]
[P. 8, fourth row, left of the summons; original in Polish]
Sweat
and its unpleasant odour
are removed by
SUDORYN
POWDER WITH A SIFTER
"AP. KOWALSKI" WARSAW
—o—

[P. 8, left column, fourth row; original in Polish]
Sweat
and its unpleasant odour
are removed by the liquid
SUDOR
"AP. KOWALSKI" WARSAW
—o—
[Notice — thanks; Dąbrowa Górnicza.]
[P. 8, right column, fifth row; original in Yiddish]
Most heartfelt thanks
to Doctors Weinzieher, Pławner and
the feldsher Mittelman for their untiring,
careful work and medical help during
my wife's illness in the Sosnowiec
hospital, thanks to which she has become fully

their devoted [?] care.
309
A. L. Półtorak, Dąbrowa.
—o—
[Advertisement — headache remedy; Warsaw.]
[P. 8, fifth row, centre; original in Polish]
"KOWALSKINA"
POWDERS
are used
for persistent
headaches
Insist on the mark
"HEART IN A RING"
[Logo: a heart inside a ring, with the letters A K]
Chemical-pharmaceutical factory "AP. KOWALSKI", WARSAW
—o—
[Advertisement — storerooms for rent; Będzin.]
[P. 8, fifth row, left of the Kowalskina ad; original in Yiddish]
Modern and convenient storerooms
in the centre of Będzin for rent at moderate
prices at Kurland's, Będzin, Kołłątaja 33.
6
—o—
[Advertisement — waste paper (old newspapers); Będzin.]
[P. 8, left column, fifth row; original in Yiddish]
Old newspapers
(waste paper)
obtainable at Szpigelman's bookshop.
—o—
[Advertisement — baby powder; general.]
[P. 8, narrow strip at the bottom of the ads, left; original in Yiddish script and Polish]
Mother [?] and child's powder [?] —
Bebe powder of Szofman
—o—
[Advertisement — the paper's own notice (advertising and subscription rates); Będzin.]
[P. 8, foot of the page above the imprint; original in Polish]
ADVERTISING RATES: Per 1 millimetre line: before the text (column VIII) 40 gr., after the text (column VIII) 20 gr., in the text (column V) 60 gr., obituaries (column VIII) 15 gr.
The administration is not responsible for printing on a set date or for keeping to the placement of advertisements. ——— Cheque account P. K. O. Warsaw No. 60.849.
SUBSCRIPTION RATES: Monthly subscription with home delivery or by post 1.10, quarterly — 3.30 [?], price of a copy 25 groszy.
—o—
Prudent financial policy.
The P.K.O. has more than one and a half million regular customers, who place their savings in this institution. The P.K.O. owes this enormous popularity above all to its prudent financial policy, to the unshakeable security guaranteed to the money deposited, and to the legally secured absolute secrecy of the deposits.

[Ogłoszenie — średnia szkoła handlowa; Będzin.]
[Str. 8, dział ogłoszeń, górny rząd po prawej; oryginał po polsku (nagłówek) i w jidysz]
3-kl. Średnia Szkoła Handlowa
z prawami szkół państwowych
MARJI BOJARSKIEJ w BĘDZINIE, ul. Kołłątaja 45,
telefon 5-47
podaje do wiadomości, że w kancelarii szkoły codziennie od 10
do 14 przyjmuje się nowe uczennice bez egzaminu, które ukończyły szkołę
powszechną lub 3 kl. gimnazjum dawnego typu. Szkoła handlowa ma
prawa średniej szkoły kupieckiej. Uczennice z innych miast płacą
za kolej tylko 25 proc. Opłaty zostały zniżone. Do 2
i 3 klasy przyjmuje się uczennice, które otrzymały promocję w
tych samych klasach innych szkół kupieckich.
209
—o—
[Ogłoszenie — pensjonat; Kamieńsk.]
[Str. 8, górny rząd, środek; oryginał w jidysz]
Kto
przyjeżdża do
Kamieńska,
idzie od razu do pensjonatu pani Mirowskiej,
willa dr. Kahna (dawniej „Willa Róża"),
bo tylko w tym pensjonacie są
wygodne, słoneczne, eleganckie pokoje, najlepsze potrawy,
ściśle koszerne i tanio. Każdy gość otrzymuje na
powrót do domu bezpłatny bilet.
412
—o—

Kredens
do jadalni, z lustrem,
w najlepszym stanie, okazyjnie

u Lem[—]owicza, Będzin, 3-go
Maja 11.
—o—

[Str. 8, lewa kolumna u góry; oryginał w jidysz, nazwa produktu po polsku]
[Rysunek: pięciu lekarzy oglądających schemat narządów trawienia; pod spodem odręcznie: „Ratujcie swoje zdrowie" [?]]
Najsłynniejsi lekarze świata stwierdzili,

D-ra LAUERA

Do nabycia w aptekach i składach aptecznych.

Willa „Juckera 572

Odciski

[Str. 8, prawa kolumna, trzeci rząd; oryginał w jidysz]
— W —
Krynicy, Rajczy, Bystrej
można kupić pojedyncze numery
„Zaglembier Cajtung"
